Flow.description: Shared case intake logic v16. Fix 1 (carried from v15): blank-check hardening — formula_HasContact/HasPhone/HasAccount/HasCaseId use NOT(ISBLANK()) instead of IsNull on inp_ContactId/inp_Phone/inp_AccountId/inp_CaseId, so an empty string from the voice wrapper no longer wins the 'prefilled' branch. Fix 2 (new): dynamic BU picklist — Get_BU_Values (CaseBUPicklistPicker) is called before Screen_Case_Details with csc={!$User.Customer_service_center__c}; its choices output (List<BUChoice>) fills col_BU_Choices, bound to Collection Choice Set CS_BU_Dynamic on BU_Pick, replacing the static Choice_BU_0..5. BU values are now filtered by the user's Customer Service Center. Range filtered by BU on the same Case Details screen: seven per-BU Range dropdowns shown reactively via BU visibility, populated by the Apex per-BU Range lists; a formula collects the chosen value; the old static all-values Range dropdown was removed. Voice finish-screen wording clarified (no false auto-refresh claim; states the call will be linked to the case). Draft on top of Active v14.

formulas.description: Last 8 digits of the normalized input phone number
formulas.name: formula_PhoneLast8
formula_Range
formulas.expression: IF({!BU_Pick}='Equipment', {!Range_Equipment}, IF({!BU_Pick}='Imaging', {!Range_Imaging}, IF({!BU_Pick}='Instrumentation', {!Range_Instrumentation}, IF({!BU_Pick}='Medical', {!Range_Medical}, IF({!BU_Pick}='Other', {!Range_Other}, IF({!BU_Pick}='Pharma', {!Range_Pharma}, IF({!BU_Pick}='Owandy', {!Range_Owandy}, '')))))))

formulas.name: formula_SousType
formulas.expression: IF({!Thematic_Pick}='Product Problem', {!SousType_PP}, IF({!Thematic_Pick}='Product use', {!SousType_PU}, IF({!Thematic_Pick}='Demande non-technique', {!SousType_NT}, {!SousType_GC})))
